about: The reference shot list of tools/macos/golden.py (docs/macos/PLAN.md P1.19, P1.18). Route entries are input script commands (src/game/input_script.cpp) joined by |; {shot:id} is where shot id is taken. Changing a route or a setting changes what a shot id shows: recapture every label compared against it.

notes.headless: every run is --headless: a fixed step of 1/tick_rate per frame instead of the wall clock, no window, no vsync, no audio device; PT_HEADLESS_ONLY makes the game refuse a run that would open a window
notes.seed: --seed 2014 as the loop browser previews (kLoopPreviewSeed): it seeds the game's and the sound system's random rolls
notes.bug_screen, f160_light: --bug-screen 1 and --f160-light 1, as the previews: the two random rolls of the game that are not drawn from the seed
notes.demo_rate: 20: the cutscenes run 20 times faster where nothing is shot (as tools/walkthrough.py); a route sets srate 1 around a cutscene frame it shoots, so the frame is the same at any speed
notes.audio: --audio-offline mixes the sound frame by frame without a device: the cutscenes and subtitles that follow the sound clock follow the game clock instead
notes.shot_warmup, shot_settle: 30 frames rendered on the shot's game frame before it is taken, after the exposure is reset (--shot-settle): the eye adaptation, the reflection and mirror captures and the occlusion settle the same way every run, whatever was rendered before
notes.render_all: off: only the shot frames and their warm-up are rendered, so the frame counter that drives the shader noise counts the same frames every run. The motion run renders every frame (motion blur needs the previous frame), deterministic as well
notes.film_grain: on (1.0, the default): the grain's offset is drawn from a fixed seed once per game frame (Game::Update), so it repeats exactly; it is one of the P1.18 effects
notes.settings: the run's own pt.ini (--settings) with the upstream defaults written out, never the user's: upscaler off (no jitter, no temporal history; none of the SDKs exists on the Mac), ray tracing off (no ray queries on MoltenVK), enhanced textures off (an external AI upscaler and a cache), letterbox off, camera roll 1
notes.language: PT_SYSTEM_LANGUAGE en-US: the option defaults and the subtitle language follow it
notes.locks: --no-release-locks so the loop browser's picks work in any build configuration; --street-offer never so the credits never stop at the question; --no-save, --no-mods, --no-update-check
notes.size: 1280x720: large enough to see a broken shadow or a font, small enough for a quick capture and a 13 MB set of dumps per shot
notes.dumps: PT_TARGET_DUMP=1 for the runs marked dump: SceneRenderer::DumpTargets writes the G-buffer, depth, lighting, occlusion, particles, reflection, HDR and mirror targets of each shot (for the per pass checks of P3.10 and P4.8)
notes.viewer: the stage viewer runs are debug views (PT_DEBUG_VIEW) of the static hallway: its lit view is near black on this build (only the light sprites show), so it says little; albedo and normals check the meshes, textures and G-buffer without the game

shots.look: a script camera at the same spot turned towards the wall lamp (0.65, 1.87, 15.75), about 2 m away: bloom around the lamp and the faint flare ghost on the opposite side of the frame centre (fx_sh_flrlgt02_s3)
